scopeNotes: This is a checksum-verified upstream source snapshot set, not a claim that the CDN binaries have been independently rebuilt byte-for-byte.
LibreOffice core build ID is embedded in the binary filesystem. Qt/Emscripten branches are publicly identified by the distributor, but an exact per-component CDN build SBOM is not provided.

LibreOffice external source tarballs are not inside the core Git archive. LIBREOFFICE-EXTERNAL-SOURCES.lst records the upstream filenames/checksums; source releases must additionally include the dependencies selected by the actual build configuration.

A complete distribution must also include this application source, its build scripts/lockfiles, the local zeta.js patch, applicable notices, and any source/object material required by the selected licenses.
Python runtime versions are platform-specific build facts; 3.12.14 must not be relabeled as corresponding source for another installed Python version.
